### File: `game/client/entity_system.h` (client.dll)
```cpp
#ifndef CS2_CLIENT_ENTITY_SYSTEM_H
#define CS2_CLIENT_ENTITY_SYSTEM_H

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstddef>
#include "../shared/entity_handle.h"

namespace cs2::client {

#define CS2_PAD(bytes, name) private: [[maybe_unused]] std::uint8_t name[bytes]; public:

constexpr std::uint32_t MAX_TOTAL_ENTITIES   = 32768; // 64 chunks * 512 slots
constexpr std::uint32_t ENTITIES_PER_CHUNK   = 512;   // 0x200 slots per chunk
constexpr std::uint32_t MAX_CHUNKS           = 64;    // 0x40 chunks in table

/**
 * @brief Authoritative Entity Identity Descriptor (CEntityIdentity)
 * Size: exactly 112 bytes (0x70), alignas(8).
 * Cacheline-aligned metadata container residing directly inside the 2D chunk array.
 */
struct alignas(8) CEntityIdentity {
    void*                 m_pEntity{nullptr};        // +0x00: Active C_BaseEntity pointer (null if slot free)
    void*                 m_pClassInfo{nullptr};     // +0x08: Runtime CSchemaClassInfo pointer
    shared::CEntityHandle m_entityHandle{};          // +0x10: 32-bit handle (15-bit index, 17-bit serial)
    std::uint32_t         m_flags{0};                // +0x14: Flags (0x02 = dormant, 0x04 = queued deletion)
    CS2_PAD(0x40, m_pad18);                          // +0x18: Internal entity identity state
    CEntityIdentity*      m_pPrev{nullptr};          // +0x58: Singly linked bucket pointer
    CEntityIdentity*      m_pNext{nullptr};          // +0x60: Singly linked bucket pointer
    CS2_PAD(0x08, m_pad68);                          // +0x68

    [[nodiscard]] constexpr bool IsDormant() const noexcept { return (m_flags & 0x02) != 0; }
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr bool IsQueuedForDeletion() const noexcept { return (m_flags & 0x04) != 0; }
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr bool IsActive() const noexcept { return m_pEntity != nullptr && !IsDormant() && !IsQueuedForDeletion(); }
};
static_assert(sizeof(CEntityIdentity) == 0x70, "CEntityIdentity must be exactly 0x70 (112 bytes)");

/**
 * @brief Source 2 Entity System Master Singleton (CGameEntitySystem)
 * Total Size: 8,576 bytes (0x2180).
 * Global Pointer in client.dll: client.dll + 0x271c8b8.
 */
class CGameEntitySystem {
public:
    virtual ~CGameEntitySystem() = default;

    // Slot 1: Release
    virtual void Release() = 0;

    // Slot 2: GetEntityIdentity (RVA: +0x007357c0, VA: 0x1807357c0)
    virtual CEntityIdentity* GetEntityIdentity(int nIndex) = 0;

    // Slot 3: GetEntityByIndex
    virtual void* GetEntityByIndex(int nIndex) = 0;

    CS2_PAD(0x08, m_pad0);
    // +0x10: 2D Chunk Page-Table (64 pointers to 512-slot CEntityIdentity pages)
    CEntityIdentity* m_EntityChunks[MAX_CHUNKS]{};
    CS2_PAD(0x2170 - (MAX_CHUNKS * sizeof(void*)), m_padChunks);

    /**
     * @brief Resolves a 32-bit entity handle into a CEntityIdentity pointer.
     * Matches client.dll @ 0x1807357c0 O(1) resolution algorithm.
     */
    [[nodiscard]] CEntityIdentity* ResolveIdentity(shared::CEntityHandle handle) const noexcept;

    /**
     * @brief Resolves an entity pointer by handle, verifying that serial numbers match.
     */
    [[nodiscard]] void* ResolveEntity(shared::CEntityHandle handle) const noexcept;
};

#undef CS2_PAD

} // namespace cs2::client

#endif // CS2_CLIENT_ENTITY_SYSTEM_H
```

```cpp
// Standard Source 2 button bitmasks
enum MoveButtonBits : uint64_t {
    IN_ATTACK       = (1ULL << 0),
    IN_JUMP         = (1ULL << 1),
    IN_DUCK         = (1ULL << 2),
    IN_FORWARD      = (1ULL << 3),
    IN_BACK         = (1ULL << 4),
    IN_USE          = (1ULL << 5),
    IN_CANCEL       = (1ULL << 6),
    IN_LEFT         = (1ULL << 7),
    IN_RIGHT        = (1ULL << 8),
    IN_MOVELEFT     = (1ULL << 9),
    IN_MOVERIGHT    = (1ULL << 10),
    IN_ATTACK2      = (1ULL << 11),
    IN_RUN          = (1ULL << 12),
    IN_RELOAD       = (1ULL << 13),
    IN_ALT1         = (1ULL << 14),
    IN_ALT2         = (1ULL << 15),

    IN_WALK         = (1ULL << 17),
    IN_ZOOM         = (1ULL << 19),

/**
 * @brief Source 2 Player Movement & Ground Physics Pipeline
 * Reconstructed clean-room implementation from client.dll (FUN_1808df090, FUN_1808ea1b0, FUN_1808bee90, FUN_1808bfa30)
 */
class CPlayerMovement {
public:
    // Core Engine Physics Constants
    static constexpr float TICK_INTERVAL             = 1.0f / 64.0f; // 0.015625s
    static constexpr float SV_GRAVITY                = 800.0f;       // u/s^2 (sv_gravity)
    static constexpr float SV_FRICTION               = 5.2f;         // sv_friction
    static constexpr float SV_STOPSPEED              = 100.0f;       // sv_stopspeed
    static constexpr float SV_ACCELERATE             = 5.5f;         // sv_accelerate
    static constexpr float SV_AIRACCELERATE          = 12.0f;        // sv_airaccelerate
    static constexpr float SV_AIR_MAX_WISHSPEED      = 30.0f;        // sv_air_max_wishspeed
    static constexpr float SV_MAXSPEED               = 320.0f;       // sv_maxspeed
    static constexpr float SV_STEPSIZE               = 18.0f;        // sv_stepsize
    static constexpr float SV_STANDABLE_NORMAL_Z     = 0.7f;         // Cosine of 45.57 deg max walkable slope
    static constexpr float SV_JUMP_IMPULSE           = 301.993378f;  // sqrt(2 * 800 * 57)
    static constexpr float CS_DUCK_SPEED_MULTIPLIER  = 0.34f;        // Crouch speed scalar
    static constexpr float CS_WALK_SPEED_MULTIPLIER  = 0.52f;        // Shift walking scalar

    // Master execution dispatcher (FUN_1808df090)
    static void ProcessMovement(PlayerMovementServices& services, PlayerMoveData& mv, float dt);

    // Ground locomotion pipeline (FUN_1808ea1b0)
    static void WalkMove(PlayerMovementServices& services, PlayerMoveData& mv, float dt);

    // Airborne locomotion pipeline (FUN_1808e57b0)
    static void AirMove(PlayerMovementServices& services, PlayerMoveData& mv, float dt);

    // Ground surface friction (FUN_1808cbf50)
    static void Friction(PlayerMovementServices& services, PlayerMoveData& mv, float dt);

    // Directional ground acceleration with weapon and stance scaling (FUN_1808bee90 / FUN_1808bef60)
    static void Accelerate(PlayerMovementServices& services, PlayerMoveData& mv,
                           const Vector3& wishdir, float wishspeed, float accel, float dt);

    // Airborne strafe acceleration clamped to sv_air_max_wishspeed (FUN_1808bfa30)
    static void AirAccelerate(PlayerMovementServices& services, PlayerMoveData& mv,
                              const Vector3& wishdir, float wishspeed, float accel, float dt);

    // Surface detection and ground snapping (FUN_1808e6020)
    static void CategorizePosition(PlayerMovementServices& services, PlayerMoveData& mv, float dt);

    // Stair and curb obstacle stepping (FUN_1808e1940)
    static void StepMove(PlayerMovementServices& services, PlayerMoveData& mv, float dt);

    // Jump button handling and sub-tick impulse generation (FUN_1808c34f0 / FUN_1808e7e70)
    static bool CheckJumpButton(PlayerMovementServices& services, PlayerMoveData& mv, float dt);

    // Sub-tick continuous jump velocity modulation (FUN_1808c0460)
    static float CalculateSubtickJumpVelocity(const PlayerMovementServices& services,
                                              float subtickFraction, float horizontalSpeed);

    // Helper: Environment trace simulation (swept AABB against world geometry)
    static MoveTrace_t TracePlayerBBox(const Vector3& start, const Vector3& end,
                                       const PlayerMovementServices& services);

    // Helper: Clip velocity against collision plane normal
    static void ClipVelocity(const Vector3& in, const Vector3& normal, Vector3& out, float overbounce = 1.0f);
};

} // namespace cs2::client

#endif // CS2_CLIENT_MOVEMENT_H
```

```cpp
#ifndef CS2_CLIENT_SUBTICK_PREDICTION_H
#define CS2_CLIENT_SUBTICK_PREDICTION_H

#include "viewmatrix.h"
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>

namespace cs2::client {

enum InButtonBits : uint64_t {
    IN_ATTACK       = (1ULL << 0),
    IN_JUMP         = (1ULL << 1),
    IN_DUCK         = (1ULL << 2),
    IN_FORWARD      = (1ULL << 3),
    IN_BACK         = (1ULL << 4),
    IN_USE          = (1ULL << 5),
    IN_MOVELEFT     = (1ULL << 9),
    IN_MOVERIGHT    = (1ULL << 10),
    IN_SPEED        = (1ULL << 16),
};

struct SubTickMoveStep {
    float when;        // 0.0 to 1.0 (sub-tick fractional offset)
    uint64_t button;   // InButtonBits
    bool pressed;      // true if pressed, false if released
};

struct UserCmd {
    uint32_t commandNumber;
    uint32_t clientTick;
    float forwardMove;
    float sideMove;
    QAngle viewAngles;
    uint64_t buttons;
    std::vector<SubTickMoveStep> subTickMoves;
};

struct PlayerMovementState {
    Vector3 origin;
    Vector3 velocity;
    bool onGround;
    float stamina;
};

/**
 * @brief Reconstructed Sub-Tick Movement Prediction from client.dll
 * Multi-slice continuous physics solver matching CS2 continuous analog jump timing.
 */
class CSubtickPrediction {
public:
    static constexpr float TICK_INTERVAL = 1.0f / 64.0f; // 0.015625s
    static constexpr float GRAVITY = 800.0f;             // u/s^2
    static constexpr float JUMP_IMPULSE = 301.993378f;   // sqrt(2 * 800 * 57)
    static constexpr float FRICTION = 5.2f;

    static void PredictUserCmd(PlayerMovementState& state, const UserCmd& cmd);
    static void SimulateGroundFriction(PlayerMovementState& state, float dt);
    static void SimulateAirborne(PlayerMovementState& state, float dt);
};
```

### File: `game/client/usercmd_wire.h` (client.dll)
```cpp
#ifndef CS2_CLIENT_USERCMD_WIRE_H
#define CS2_CLIENT_USERCMD_WIRE_H

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstddef>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <optional>
#include <algorithm>
#include "viewmatrix.h"

namespace cs2::client {

// ============================================================================
// Source 2 UserCmd Wire & Protobuf Definitions
// Reconstructed via Ghidra static decompilation of client.dll and networksystem.dll
// ============================================================================

/**
 * @brief Standard Source 2 button bitmasks (64-bit uint64).
 */
enum InButtonBits : uint64_t {
    IN_ATTACK       = (1ULL << 0),
    IN_JUMP         = (1ULL << 1),
    IN_DUCK         = (1ULL << 2),
    IN_FORWARD      = (1ULL << 3),
    IN_BACK         = (1ULL << 4),
    IN_USE          = (1ULL << 5),
    IN_CANCEL       = (1ULL << 6),
    IN_LEFT         = (1ULL << 7),
    IN_RIGHT        = (1ULL << 8),
    IN_MOVELEFT     = (1ULL << 9),
    IN_MOVERIGHT    = (1ULL << 10),
    IN_ATTACK2      = (1ULL << 11),
    IN_RUN          = (1ULL << 12),
    IN_RELOAD       = (1ULL << 13),
    IN_ALT1         = (1ULL << 14),
    IN_ALT2         = (1ULL << 15),
    IN_SPEED        = (1ULL << 16),
    IN_WALK         = (1ULL << 17),
    IN_ZOOM         = (1ULL << 19),
    IN_FIRST_MOD    = (1ULL << 20),
    IN_SECOND_MOD   = (1ULL << 21),
    IN_BULLRUSH     = (1ULL << 22),
    IN_GRENADE1     = (1ULL << 23),
    IN_GRENADE2     = (1ULL << 24),
    IN_ATTACK3      = (1ULL << 25),
};

/**
 * @brief Protobuf Wire Types (Google Protobuf specification).
 */
enum class WireType : uint32_t {
    VarInt          = 0,
    Fixed64         = 1,
    LengthDelimited = 2,
    StartGroup      = 3, // deprecated
    EndGroup        = 4, // deprecated
    Fixed32         = 5,
};

/**
 * @brief Lightweight low-level binary buffer reader for protobuf parsing.
 */
class CByteStreamReader {
public:
    CByteStreamReader(const uint8_t* data, size_t size)
        : m_pData(data), m_nSize(size), m_nOffset(0) {}

    [[nodiscard]] bool HasMore() const noexcept { return m_nOffset < m_nSize; }
    [[nodiscard]] size_t GetOffset() const noexcept { return m_nOffset; }
    [[nodiscard]] size_t GetRemaining() const noexcept { return m_nOffset < m_nSize ? m_nSize - m_nOffset : 0; }
    [[nodiscard]] const uint8_t* CurrentPtr() const noexcept { return m_pData + m_nOffset; }

    bool ReadByte(uint8_t& outByte);
    bool ReadVarInt32(uint32_t& outVal);
    bool ReadVarInt64(uint64_t& outVal);
    bool ReadFixed32(uint32_t& outVal);
    bool ReadFloat(float& outVal);
    bool ReadFixed64(uint64_t& outVal);
    bool ReadDouble(double& outVal);
    bool ReadBytes(uint8_t* outDest, size_t len);
    bool ReadString(std::string& outStr, size_t len);
    bool Skip(size_t len);
    bool SkipField(WireType wireType);

private:
    const uint8_t* m_pData;
    size_t m_nSize;
    size_t m_nOffset;
};

/**
 * @brief Lightweight low-level binary buffer writer for protobuf serialization.
 */
class CByteStreamWriter {
public:
    CByteStreamWriter() = default;

    void WriteByte(uint8_t b) { m_Buffer.push_back(b); }
    void WriteVarInt32(uint32_t val);
    void WriteVarInt64(uint64_t val);
    void WriteFixed32(uint32_t val);
    void WriteFloat(float val);
    void WriteFixed64(uint64_t val);
    void WriteDouble(double val);
    void WriteTag(uint32_t fieldNumber, WireType wireType);
    void WriteLengthDelimited(const uint8_t* data, size_t len);
    void WriteString(const std::string& str);
    void WriteBytes(const uint8_t* data, size_t len);

    [[nodiscard]] const std::vector<uint8_t>& GetData() const noexcept { return m_Buffer; }
    [[nodiscard]] size_t GetSize() const noexcept { return m_Buffer.size(); }
    void Clear() noexcept { m_Buffer.clear(); }

private:
    std::vector<uint8_t> m_Buffer;
};

/**
 * @brief CSubtickMoveStep exact memory layout and wire codec.
 * Reconstructed from client.dll:
 *   - VTable: 0x181b2d4d8 (baseline) / 0x181b2f488 (current)
 *   - Size: 0x38 (56 bytes)
 *   - Parse: FUN_1804f4950 (baseline) / FUN_1804f5640 (current)
 *   - Serialize: FUN_1804f4c40 (baseline) / FUN_1804f5930 (current)
 */
class CSubtickMoveStep {
public:
    void* m_pVTable{nullptr};            // +0x00: vtable pointer
    void* m_pInternalArena{nullptr};     // +0x08: Google protobuf Arena pointer
    uint32_t m_nHasBits{0};              // +0x10: _has_bits_ mask
    mutable int32_t m_nCachedSize{0};    // +0x14: _cached_size_
    uint64_t m_nButton{0};               // +0x18: field 1: button mask
    bool m_bPressed{false};              // +0x20: field 2: keydown edge
    uint8_t m_nPad[3]{0, 0, 0};          // +0x21..0x23: alignment padding
    float m_flWhen{0.0f};                // +0x24: field 3: normalized fraction [0.0, 1.0]
    float m_flAnalogForwardDelta{0.0f};  // +0x28: field 4: analog forward delta
    float m_flAnalogLeftDelta{0.0f};     // +0x2c: field 5: analog left delta
    float m_flAnalogPitchDelta{0.0f};    // +0x30: field 8: analog pitch delta
    float m_flAnalogYawDelta{0.0f};      // +0x34: field 9: analog yaw delta

    // Has-bits bitmasks (from FUN_1804f4c40)
    enum HasBits : uint32_t {
        HAS_BUTTON               = (1 << 0), // 0x01
        HAS_PRESSED              = (1 << 1), // 0x02
        HAS_WHEN                 = (1 << 2), // 0x04
        HAS_ANALOG_FORWARD_DELTA = (1 << 3), // 0x08
        HAS_ANALOG_LEFT_DELTA    = (1 << 4), // 0x10
        HAS_ANALOG_PITCH_DELTA   = (1 << 5), // 0x20
        HAS_ANALOG_YAW_DELTA     = (1 << 6), // 0x40
    };

    CSubtickMoveStep() = default;

    // Field setters with automatic has-bits tracking
    void SetButton(uint64_t btn) noexcept { m_nButton = btn; m_nHasBits |= HAS_BUTTON; }
    void SetPressed(bool pressed) noexcept { m_bPressed = pressed; m_nHasBits |= HAS_PRESSED; }
    void SetWhen(float when) noexcept { m_flWhen = std::clamp(when, 0.0f, 1.0f); m_nHasBits |= HAS_WHEN; }
    void SetAnalogForwardDelta(float delta) noexcept { m_flAnalogForwardDelta = delta; m_nHasBits |= HAS_ANALOG_FORWARD_DELTA; }
    void SetAnalogLeftDelta(float delta) noexcept { m_flAnalogLeftDelta = delta; m_nHasBits |= HAS_ANALOG_LEFT_DELTA; }
    void SetAnalogPitchDelta(float delta) noexcept { m_flAnalogPitchDelta = delta; m_nHasBits |= HAS_ANALOG_PITCH_DELTA; }
    void SetAnalogYawDelta(float delta) noexcept { m_flAnalogYawDelta = delta; m_nHasBits |= HAS_ANALOG_YAW_DELTA; }

    [[nodiscard]] size_t ByteSizeLong() const;
    void _InternalSerialize(CByteStreamWriter& writer) const;
    bool _InternalParse(CByteStreamReader& reader);
};
static_assert(sizeof(CSubtickMoveStep) == 0x38, "CSubtickMoveStep memory layout mismatch (must be 56 bytes)");

/**

    int32_t player_tick_count{0};
    float player_tick_fraction{0.0f};
    Vector3 target_head_pos_check{0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};
    Vector3 target_abs_pos_check{0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};

    [[nodiscard]] size_t ByteSizeLong() const;
    void _InternalSerialize(CByteStreamWriter& writer) const;
    bool _InternalParse(CByteStreamReader& reader);
};

/**
 * @brief CBaseUserCmdPB exact memory layout and wire codec.
 * Reconstructed from client.dll:
 *   - VTable: 0x181b2d618 (baseline) / 0x181b2f5c8 (current)
 *   - Parse: FUN_1804f5c00 (baseline) / FUN_1804f68f0 (current)
 *   - Serialize: FUN_1804f63f0 (baseline) / FUN_1804f70e0 (current)
 *
 * Wire Tags:
 *   - field 1: command_number (tag 0x08, wire 0)
 *   - field 2: client_tick (tag 0x10, wire 0)
 *   - field 3: buttons_pb (tag 0x1A, wire 2)
 *   - field 5: forwardmove (tag 0x2D, wire 5)
 *   - field 6: leftmove (tag 0x35, wire 5)
 *   - field 7: upmove (tag 0x3D, wire 5)
 *   - field 18: repeated subtick_moves (tag 0x92 0x01, wire 2)
 *   - field 19: move_crc (tag 0x9A 0x01, wire 2)
 *   - field 20: consumed_server_angle_changes (tag 0xA0 0x01, wire 0)
 *   - field 21: cmd_flags (tag 0xA8 0x01, wire 0)
 */
class CBaseUserCmdPB {
public:
    uint32_t m_nHasBits{0};
    int32_t m_nCommandNumber{0};
    int32_t m_nClientTick{0};
    CInButtonStatePB m_ButtonsPB;
    float m_flForwardMove{0.0f};
    float m_flLeftMove{0.0f};
    float m_flUpMove{0.0f};
    QAngle m_ViewAngles{0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};
    std::vector<CSubtickMoveStep> m_SubtickMoves; // Field 18 (tag 0x92 0x01)
    std::string m_strMoveCRC;
    int32_t m_nConsumedServerAngleChanges{0};
    int32_t m_nCmdFlags{0};

    enum HasBits : uint32_t {
        HAS_COMMAND_NUMBER                 = (1 << 4),  // 0x10
        HAS_CLIENT_TICK                    = (1 << 5),  // 0x20
        HAS_BUTTONS_PB                     = (1 << 1),  // 0x02
        HAS_FORWARDMOVE                    = (1 << 6),  // 0x40
        HAS_LEFTMOVE                       = (1 << 7),  // 0x80
        HAS_UPMOVE                         = (1 << 8),  // 0x100
        HAS_VIEWANGLES                     = (1 << 9),  // 0x200
        HAS_MOVE_CRC                       = (1 << 0),  // 0x01
        HAS_CONSUMED_SERVER_ANGLE_CHANGES  = (1 << 15), // 0x8000
        HAS_CMD_FLAGS                      = (1 << 16), // 0x10000
    };

    CBaseUserCmdPB() = default;

    [[nodiscard]] size_t ByteSizeLong() const;
    void _InternalSerialize(CByteStreamWriter& writer) const;
    bool _InternalParse(CByteStreamReader& reader);
};

/**
 * @brief CSGOUserCmdPB wrapper framing Base UserCmd and Input History shots.
 * Reconstructed from client.dll:

    int32_t m_nAttack3StartHistoryIndex{-1};

    enum HasBits : uint32_t {
        HAS_BASE                           = (1 << 0), // 0x01
        HAS_ATTACK1_START_HISTORY_INDEX    = (1 << 5), // 0x20
        HAS_ATTACK2_START_HISTORY_INDEX    = (1 << 6), // 0x40
        HAS_HAS_BEEN_PREDICTED             = (1 << 1), // 0x02
        HAS_ATTACK3_START_HISTORY_INDEX    = (1 << 2), // 0x04
    };

    CSGOUserCmdPB() = default;

    bool _InternalParse(CByteStreamReader& reader);

/**
 * @brief CCLCMsg_Move network packet encapsulation (clc_Move, NetMessage 0x15).
 * Reconstructed from networksystem.dll and client.dll:
 *   - NetMessage ID: 0x15 (21)
 *   - Wire format:
 *       field 1: num_backup_commands (uint32, tag 0x08)

class CCLCMsg_Move {

    [[nodiscard]] size_t ByteSizeLong() const;
    void _InternalSerialize(CByteStreamWriter& writer) const;
    bool _InternalParse(CByteStreamReader& reader);
};

/**
 * @brief Reconstructed CSGOInput client-side user command coordinator.
 * Reconstructed from client.dll (FUN_180cfa6b0 / CSGOInput::CreateMove).
 */
class CSGOInputWireCodec {
public:
    static constexpr float DEFAULT_TICK_INTERVAL = 1.0f / 64.0f; // 0.015625s

    /**
     * @brief Computes normalized sub-tick fraction w in [0.0, 1.0] and instantiates CSubtickMoveStep.
     */
    static CSubtickMoveStep CreateSubtickMoveStep(
        uint64_t button,
        bool pressed,
        double eventTimestampSec,
        double tickStartTimestampSec,
        float tickInterval = DEFAULT_TICK_INTERVAL,
        float analogForwardDelta = 0.0f,
        float analogLeftDelta = 0.0f
    );

    /**
     * @brief Encodes variable-bit NetMessage ID (6, 10, 14, or 34 bits) as used by networksystem.dll.
     */
    static void WriteVariableBitMessageId(std::vector<uint8_t>& bitstream, size_t& bitOffset, uint32_t messageId);

    /**
     * @brief Decodes variable-bit NetMessage ID header from bitstream.
     */
    static uint32_t ReadVariableBitMessageId(const uint8_t* bitstream, size_t& bitOffset, size_t maxBits);

    /**
     * @brief Serializes a CSGOUserCmdPB into a clc_Move wire payload.
     */
    static std::vector<uint8_t> SerializeUserCmdToBitbuf(
        const CSGOUserCmdPB& userCmd,
        uint32_t numBackupCommands = 0,
        uint32_t numNewCommands = 1
    );

    /**
     * @brief Unpacks a clc_Move netmessage payload back into CSGOUserCmdPB commands.
     */
    static bool UnpackUserCmdFromBitbuf(
        const uint8_t* payloadData,
        size_t payloadSize,
        std::vector<CSGOUserCmdPB>& outCmds,
        uint32_t& outNumBackup,
        uint32_t& outNumNew
    );
};
```

```cpp
    Vector3 velocity{};
    QAngle eyeAngles{};
    bool onGround = true;
    bool ducking = false;
    bool onLadder = false;
    int32_t boostStackCount = 0; // Stacked atop other players
};

/**
 * @brief Recoil aim punch spring-damper state (CPlayer_AimPunchServices).
 */
struct AimPunchState {
    int32_t m_predictableBaseTick = 0;            // +0x0048
    float m_predictableBaseTickInterpAmount = 0.0f; // +0x004c
    QAngle m_aimPunchAngle{};                     // +0x0050 (m_predictableBaseAngle)
    QAngle m_aimPunchAngleVel{};                  // +0x005c (m_predictableBaseAngleVel)
};

/**
 * @brief 2D spread deflection vector on the view plane.
 */
struct SpreadVector2D {
    float x = 0.0f;
    float y = 0.0f;
};

/**
 * @brief Global engine ConVars controlling accuracy and recoil physics.
 */
struct AccuracyConVars {
    bool sv_turning_inaccuracy_enabled = true;
    float sv_turning_inaccuracy_angle_min = 1.0f;     // deg
    float sv_turning_inaccuracy_decay = 0.90f;        // rate per evaluation
    bool sv_strafing_inaccuracy_enabled = true;
    float sv_strafing_inaccuracy_bias = 0.45f;
    float sv_strafing_inaccuracy_scale = 0.65f;
    float weapon_accuracy_forcespread = 0.0f;
    bool weapon_accuracy_nospread = false;
    int32_t weapon_accuracy_stack_boost_limit = 1;
    float weapon_recoil_decay = 4.5f;                 // Second-order spring damping
};

/**
 * @brief Clean-room implementation of Valve's CUniformRandomStream (tier0.dll).
 * Based on Park-Miller minimal standard LCG with Bays-Durham shuffle table (ran1).
 */
class CUniformRandomStream {
private:
    int32_t m_idum = 0;
    int32_t m_iy = 0;
    int32_t m_iv[32]{};

public:
    CUniformRandomStream() = default;
    explicit CUniformRandomStream(int32_t seed) { SetSeed(seed); }

    void SetSeed(int32_t seed);
    float RandomFloat(float minVal = 0.0f, float maxVal = 1.0f);
    int32_t RandomInt(int32_t minVal, int32_t maxVal);
};

/**
 * @brief Clean-room reconstructed CS2 Weapon Accuracy, Spread Cone, and Recoil Decay Pipeline.
 * Reverse engineered from client.dll:
 *   - FUN_18080c1a0 (C_CSWeaponBase::GetInaccuracy @ RVA 0x0080c1a0 / 0x0080cfd0)
 *   - FUN_180d23fe0 (FX_CalculateSpread @ RVA 0x00d23fe0 / 0x00d25630)
 *   - FUN_180827be0 (C_CSWeaponBase::UpdateAccuracyPenalty @ RVA 0x00827be0 / 0x00828a10)
 *   - FUN_18080cef0 (GetRecoveryTime @ RVA 0x0080cef0)
 *   - FUN_18085dc60 (CPlayer_AimPunchServices::SimulateAimPunchDecay @ RVA 0x0085dc60 / 0x0085ea90)
 */
class CWeaponAccuracyPipeline {
public:
    static constexpr float TICK_INTERVAL = 1.0f / 64.0f; // 0.015625s

    /**
     * @brief Evaluates recovery time based on stance, air status, and recoil index.
     * Reconstructed from FUN_18080cef0 @ RVA 0x0080cef0.
     */
    static float GetRecoveryTime(
        const CCSWeaponBaseVData_Accuracy& vdata,
        const PlayerPawnAccuracyContext& ctx,
        int32_t recoilIndex
    );

    /**
     * @brief Computes strafing-induced inaccuracy from movement velocity and eye angle.
     * Reconstructed from FUN_18080d4c0 @ RVA 0x0080d4c0.
     */
    static float CalculateStrafingInaccuracy(
        const PlayerPawnAccuracyContext& ctx,
        const AccuracyConVars& cvars
    );

    /**
     * @brief Updates turning delta and angular inaccuracy.
     * Reconstructed from FUN_180828d90 @ RVA 0x00828d90.
     */
    static void UpdateTurningInaccuracy(
        WeaponAccuracyState& state,
        const QAngle& eyeAngles,
        float dt,
        const AccuracyConVars& cvars
    );

    /**
     * @brief Main tick update for weapon accuracy penalty and recoil index decay.
     * Reconstructed from FUN_180827be0 @ RVA 0x00827be0 / 0x00828a10.
     */
    static void UpdateAccuracyPenalty(
        WeaponAccuracyState& state,
        const CCSWeaponBaseVData_Accuracy& vdata,
        const PlayerPawnAccuracyContext& ctx,
        float curTime,
        float dt,
        const AccuracyConVars& cvars
    );

    /**
     * @brief Evaluates total composite weapon inaccuracy and base spread.
     * Reconstructed from FUN_18080c1a0 @ RVA 0x0080c1a0 / 0x0080cfd0.
     */
    static float GetInaccuracy(
        const WeaponAccuracyState& state,
        const CCSWeaponBaseVData_Accuracy& vdata,
        const PlayerPawnAccuracyContext& ctx,
        float* outSpread,
        float* outJumpInacc,
        const AccuracyConVars& cvars
    );

    /**
     * @brief Retrieves intrinsic weapon spread from weapon vdata.
     */
    static float GetSpread(
        const CCSWeaponBaseVData_Accuracy& vdata,
        int32_t weaponMode = 0
    );

    /**
     * @brief Generates dual uniform disk spread deflection vector for bullet/pellet.
     * Reconstructed from FX_CalculateSpread @ RVA 0x00d23fe0 / 0x00d25630 (FUN_180d23fe0).
     *
     * Evaluates independent uniform random variates for inaccuracy disk (r1, theta1)
     * and intrinsic spread disk (r2, theta2), applying weapon-specific distributions
     * (Revolver fan-the-hammer power inversion, Negev continuous spin-up convergence)
     * and summing them vectorially.
     *
     * @param itemDefIndex Weapon item definition index (64 = revolver, 28 = negev, etc.)
     * @param bulletIndex Index of pellet/bullet in current burst
     * @param numBullets Total pellets/bullets fired in this shot
     * @param weaponMode Primary (0) or Secondary (1)
     * @param randomSeed Deterministic random seed
     * @param inaccuracy Current composite inaccuracy from GetInaccuracy
     * @param spread Intrinsic weapon spread from GetSpread
     * @param recoilIndex Current continuous recoil index
     * @param cvars Accuracy ConVars
     * @return 2D spread deflection vector (dx, dy)
     */
    static SpreadVector2D CalculateSpreadVector(
        uint16_t itemDefIndex,
        int32_t bulletIndex,
        int32_t numBullets,
        int32_t weaponMode,
        int32_t randomSeed,
        float inaccuracy,
        float spread,
        float recoilIndex,
        const AccuracyConVars& cvars
    );

    /**
     * @brief Handles weapon firing impulse: applies fire inaccuracy and recoil punch.
     */
    static void OnWeaponFired(
        WeaponAccuracyState& state,
        const CCSWeaponBaseVData_Accuracy& vdata,
        AimPunchState& punchState,
        float curTime
    );

    /**
     * @brief Simulates second-order recoil aim punch ODE spring damping per tick.
     * Reconstructed from FUN_18085dc60 @ RVA 0x0085dc60 and FUN_18084d8b0 @ RVA 0x0084d8b0.
     */
    static void SimulateAimPunchDecay(
        AimPunchState& punchState,
        float dt,
        float dampingRate = 4.5f
    );

    /**
     * @brief Generates 3D perturbed firing ray direction vector from spread deflection.
     */
    static Vector3 CalculateSpreadConeRay(
        const SpreadVector2D& spreadVec,
        const Vector3& forward,
        const Vector3& right,
        const Vector3& up
    );

    /**
     * @brief Generates 3D perturbed firing ray direction vector from spread cone (polar overload).
     */
    static Vector3 CalculateSpreadConeRay(
        float inaccuracy,
        float spread,
        float randU1,
        float randU2,
        const Vector3& forward,
        const Vector3& right,
        const Vector3& up
    );
};

} // namespace cs2::client

#endif // CS2_CLIENT_WEAPON_ACCURACY_H
```

```cpp
namespace FCVAR {
    constexpr std::uint32_t UNREGISTERED              = (1 << 0);
    constexpr std::uint32_t DEVELOPMENTONLY           = (1 << 1);
    constexpr std::uint32_t GAMEDLL                   = (1 << 2);
    constexpr std::uint32_t CLIENTDLL                 = (1 << 3);
    constexpr std::uint32_t HIDDEN                    = (1 << 4);
    constexpr std::uint32_t PROTECTED                 = (1 << 5);

    constexpr std::uint32_t ARCHIVE                   = (1 << 7);

    constexpr std::uint32_t CHEAT                     = (1 << 14);
    constexpr std::uint32_t REPLICATED                = (1 << 29);

/**
 * @brief ConVar Raw Descriptor (Source 2)

class ConVar {
public:

    ConVar*       m_pNext{nullptr};          // +0x08: Next convar node in tier0 hash table

    std::uint32_t m_nFlags{0};               // +0x18: FCVAR flags bitmask

    // Accessors

    [[nodiscard]] const char* GetHelpText() const noexcept { return m_pszDescription; }
```

### File: `game/interfaces/interfaces.h` (interfaces)
```cpp
#ifndef CS2_INTERFACES_INTERFACES_H
#define CS2_INTERFACES_INTERFACES_H

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>

namespace cs2::interfaces {

using InstantiateInterfaceFn = void* (*)();

/**
 * @brief Source 2 Internal Interface Registry Node (InterfaceReg)
 * Singly-linked list node populated by DLL exports.
 * Size: 24 bytes (0x18) on x64.
 */
struct InterfaceReg {
    InstantiateInterfaceFn m_CreateFn; // +0x00: Factory function returning interface instance
    const char*            m_pName;    // +0x08: Null-terminated versioned token string
    InterfaceReg*          m_pNext;    // +0x10: Next node in linked list
};
static_assert(sizeof(InterfaceReg) == 0x18, "InterfaceReg must be 24 bytes (0x18)");

using CreateInterfaceFn = void* (*)(const char* pName, int* pReturnCode);

/**
 * @brief Traverses an InterfaceReg linked list to locate an interface by version token.
 */
inline void* CaptureInterface(InterfaceReg* pHead, const char* pInterfaceName) noexcept {
    if (!pHead || !pInterfaceName) return nullptr;
    for (InterfaceReg* pCur = pHead; pCur; pCur = pCur->m_pNext) {
        if (pCur->m_pName && std::strcmp(pCur->m_pName, pInterfaceName) == 0) {
            return pCur->m_CreateFn ? pCur->m_CreateFn() : nullptr;
        }
    }
    return nullptr;
}

} // namespace cs2::interfaces

#endif // CS2_INTERFACES_INTERFACES_H
```

```cpp
/**
 * @brief Dispatch Sound Event Parameter Payload (StartSoundEventInfo_t)
 * Total Size: exactly 128 bytes (0x80).
 */
struct StartSoundEventInfo_t {
    shared::Vector3D     m_vecOrigin{};          // +0x00: 3D spatial emitter coordinates
    shared::QAngle       m_angAngles{};          // +0x0C: Spatial directional orientation
    float                m_flVolume{ 1.0f };     // +0x18: Linear gain amplitude [0.0..1.0]
    float                m_flPitch{ 1.0f };      // +0x1C: Frequency pitch shift factor
    shared::CEntityHandle m_hEntity{};           // +0x20: Associated emitter entity handle
    CS2_PAD(0x0C, m_pad24);                      // +0x24: Padding to 16-byte alignment
    float                m_matSpatial[3][4]{};   // +0x30: 3x4 spatial coordinate transform
    CS2_PAD(0x20, m_pad60);                      // +0x60: DSP runtime context payload
};
static_assert(sizeof(StartSoundEventInfo_t) == 0x80, "StartSoundEventInfo_t must be 128 bytes (0x80)");

/**
 * @brief Source 2 Sound Operator Subsystem (ISoundOpSystem)
 * Token: "SoundOpSystem001" in soundsystem.dll
 * VTable: 0x1804AB140 (16 slots)
 */
class ISoundOpSystem {
public:
    virtual ~ISoundOpSystem() = default;

    // Slot 1..10: IAppSystem methods
    virtual bool Connect(void* /*pFactory*/) = 0;
    virtual void Disconnect() = 0;
    virtual void* QueryInterface(const char* /*pInterfaceName*/) = 0;
    virtual int  Init() = 0;
    virtual void Shutdown() = 0;

    // Slot 11: StartSoundEvent
    virtual std::uint64_t StartSoundEvent(const char* pEventName, const StartSoundEventInfo_t* pInfo) = 0;

    // Slot 12: StartSoundEventByHash
    virtual std::uint64_t StartSoundEventByHash(std::uint32_t nEventHash, const StartSoundEventInfo_t* pInfo) = 0;

    // Slot 13: StartSoundEventReliable
    virtual std::uint64_t StartSoundEventReliable(std::uint32_t nEventHash, const StartSoundEventInfo_t* pInfo) = 0;

    // Slot 14: StopSoundEvent

    // Slot 15: SetSoundEventParam
    virtual void SetSoundEventParam(std::uint64_t nGuid, const char* pParamName, float flValue) = 0;
};

#undef CS2_PAD

} // namespace cs2::interfaces
```

### File: `game/navsystem/navmesh.h` (navsystem.dll)
```cpp
#ifndef CS2_NAVSYSTEM_NAVMESH_H
#define CS2_NAVSYSTEM_NAVMESH_H

#include <cstdint>
#include <cmath>
#include <vector>
#include <array>
#include <string>
#include <memory>
#include <queue>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <limits>
#include <algorithm>

namespace cs2::navsystem {

// Source 2 Navigation Mesh Magic Identifier (0xFEEDFACE)
constexpr uint32_t NAV_MAGIC = 0xFEEDFACE;
constexpr uint32_t NAV_VERSION = 36; // Maximum supported in CS2 (0x24)
constexpr uint32_t NAV_SUBVERSION = 2;

// Cardinal traversal directions
enum NavDirType : uint32_t {
    NORTH = 0,
    EAST = 1,
    SOUTH = 2,
    WEST = 3,
    NUM_DIRECTIONS = 4
};

// Ladder traversal directions
enum NavLadderDirType : uint32_t {
    LADDER_UP = 0,
    LADDER_DOWN = 1,
    NUM_LADDER_DIRECTIONS = 2
};

// Area navigational attribute flags
enum NavAreaFlags : uint32_t {
    NAV_MESH_INVALID        = 0,
    NAV_MESH_JUMP           = (1 << 1),   // 0x00000002: Area requires jump
    NAV_MESH_PRECISE        = (1 << 2),   // 0x00000004: Precise positioning (no shortcutting)
    NAV_MESH_NO_JUMP        = (1 << 3),   // 0x00000008: Inhibits bot jumping
    NAV_MESH_STOP           = (1 << 4),   // 0x00000010: Bot must stop briefly
    NAV_MESH_RUN            = (1 << 5),   // 0x00000020: Bot must run through
    NAV_MESH_WALK           = (1 << 6),   // 0x00000040: Bot must walk through
    NAV_MESH_AVOID          = (1 << 7),   // 0x00000080: Avoid area unless necessary
    NAV_MESH_TRANSIENT      = (1 << 8),   // 0x00000100: Dynamic/changing state (doors, breakables)
    NAV_MESH_DONT_HIDE      = (1 << 9),   // 0x00000200: Bots cannot hide here
    NAV_MESH_STAND          = (1 << 10),  // 0x00000400: Bots must stand (cannot crouch)
    NAV_MESH_NO_HOSTAGES    = (1 << 11),  // 0x00000800: Hostages excluded from entry
    NAV_MESH_STAIRS         = (1 << 12),  // 0x00001000: Staircase navigation
    NAV_MESH_OBSTACLE_TOP   = (1 << 13),  // 0x00002000: Mantle/obstacle top
    NAV_MESH_CLIFF          = (1 << 14),  // 0x00004000: Edge cliff drop-off
    NAV_MESH_CROUCH         = (1 << 16),  // 0x00010000: Must crouch
    NAV_MESH_CRAWL          = (1 << 18),  // 0x00040000: Must crawl (Source 2 addition)
    NAV_MESH_FIRST_CUSTOM   = (1 << 19)   // 0x00080000: Game-specific markup boundary
};

// Tactical hiding spot attributes
enum HidingSpotFlags : uint8_t {
    HIDING_SPOT_IN_COVER      = (1 << 0), // 0x01: High cover
    HIDING_SPOT_GOOD_SNIPER   = (1 << 1), // 0x02: Sniper vantage point
    HIDING_SPOT_IDEAL_SNIPER  = (1 << 2), // 0x04: Optimum sniper line of sight
    HIDING_SPOT_EXPOSED       = (1 << 3)  // 0x08: Exposed hiding spot
};

// 3D Cartesian Coordinate Vector
struct Vector3 {
    float x{0.0f}, y{0.0f}, z{0.0f};

    constexpr Vector3() noexcept = default;
    constexpr Vector3(float x_, float y_, float z_) noexcept : x(x_), y(y_), z(z_) {}

    Vector3 operator+(const Vector3& o) const noexcept { return {x + o.x, y + o.y, z + o.z}; }
    Vector3 operator-(const Vector3& o) const noexcept { return {x - o.x, y - o.y, z - o.z}; }
    Vector3 operator*(float s) const noexcept { return {x * s, y * s, z * s}; }
    Vector3 operator/(float s) const noexcept { return {x / s, y / s, z / s}; }

    [[nodiscard]] float Dot(const Vector3& o) const noexcept { return x * o.x + y * o.y + z * o.z; }
    [[nodiscard]] float LengthSqr() const noexcept { return Dot(*this); }
    [[nodiscard]] float Length() const noexcept { return std::sqrt(LengthSqr()); }
    [[nodiscard]] float DistTo(const Vector3& o) const noexcept { return (*this - o).Length(); }

    [[nodiscard]] Vector3 Normalized() const noexcept {
        float l = Length();
        return l > 1e-6f ? (*this) * (1.0f / l) : Vector3{0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};
    }
};

// Tactical cover marker within a CNavArea
struct HidingSpot {
    uint32_t m_id{0};
    Vector3  m_pos{0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};
    uint8_t  m_flags{0};
};

// Directional connection from one area to another
struct NavConnect_t {
    uint32_t m_areaId{0};
    uint32_t m_edgeId{0};
};

// Ladder structure in navigation mesh
struct CNavLadder {
    uint32_t m_id{0};
    float    m_width{0.0f};
    Vector3  m_top{0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};
    Vector3  m_bottom{0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};
    float    m_length{0.0f};
    NavDirType m_dir{NORTH};
    Vector3  m_normal{0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};

    // Connected area IDs
    uint32_t m_topForwardAreaId{0};
    uint32_t m_topLeftAreaId{0};
    uint32_t m_topRightAreaId{0};
    uint32_t m_topBehindAreaId{0};
    uint32_t m_bottomAreaId{0};
    uint32_t m_bottomLeftAreaId{0};
    uint32_t m_bottomRightAreaId{0};
};

// Single convex polygon region in the navigation mesh
class CNavArea {
public:
    uint32_t m_id{0};
    uint32_t m_flags{0};
    uint8_t  m_lightIntensity{0};
    Vector3  m_nwCorner{0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};
    Vector3  m_seCorner{0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};
    float    m_neZ{0.0f};
    float    m_swZ{0.0f};
    uint32_t m_placeId{0};

    // Source 2 arbitrary polygon vertices (when present)
    std::vector<Vector3> m_polyPoints;

    // Outgoing directional connections (North, East, South, West)
    std::array<std::vector<NavConnect_t>, NUM_DIRECTIONS> m_adjacentAreas;

    // Tactical hiding spots located in this area
    std::vector<HidingSpot> m_hidingSpots;

    // Ladder references (LADDER_UP, LADDER_DOWN)
    std::array<std::vector<uint32_t>, NUM_LADDER_DIRECTIONS> m_ladderConnections;

    [[nodiscard]] Vector3 GetCenter() const noexcept {
        return (m_nwCorner + m_seCorner) * 0.5f;
    }

    [[nodiscard]] bool Contains(const Vector3& pos) const noexcept;
    [[nodiscard]] float ComputeZ(float x, float y) const noexcept;
    [[nodiscard]] bool HasFlag(uint32_t flag) const noexcept { return (m_flags & flag) != 0; }
};

// Abstract path traversal cost functor interface (INavPathCost)
class INavPathCost {
public:
    virtual ~INavPathCost() = default;
    virtual float GroundCost(const CNavArea* from, const CNavArea* to, float dist) const = 0;
    virtual float LadderCost(const CNavLadder* ladder) const = 0;
    virtual bool  IsAreaBlocked(const CNavArea* area) const = 0;
    virtual bool  AllowLadders() const = 0;

    int32_t m_navHull{-1}; // Compatible agent hull index (-1 = any)
};

// Reconstructed clean-room CNavPathCost implementation
class CNavPathCost : public INavPathCost {
public:
    bool  m_bAllowLadders{true};
    bool  m_bCanFly{false};
    bool  m_bCanSwim{false};
    float m_flTransitionPenalty{0.0f};

    float GroundCost(const CNavArea* from, const CNavArea* to, float dist) const override;
    float LadderCost(const CNavLadder* ladder) const override;
    bool  IsAreaBlocked(const CNavArea* area) const override;
    bool  AllowLadders() const override { return m_bAllowLadders; }
};

// Internal A* Search OpenList Priority Queue Node
struct AStarNode {
    CNavArea*         m_area{nullptr};
    AStarNode*        m_parent{nullptr};
    const CNavLadder* m_ladder{nullptr};
    float             m_gCost{0.0f};      // Cost from start to current node
    float             m_hCost{0.0f};      // Heuristic estimate to goal
    float             m_totalCost{0.0f};  // f = g + h
    bool              m_open{false};
    bool              m_closed{false};

    struct Compare {
        bool operator()(const AStarNode* a, const AStarNode* b) const noexcept {
            return a->m_totalCost > b->m_totalCost; // Min-heap
        }
    };
};

// Core Navigation Mesh Architecture and A* Pathfinding Engine
class CNavMesh {
public:
    uint32_t m_magic{0};
    uint32_t m_version{0};
    uint32_t m_subVersion{0};
    uint32_t m_bspSize{0};
    bool     m_isAnalyzed{false};

    std::vector<std::string> m_places;
    std::vector<CNavArea>    m_areas;
    std::vector<CNavLadder>  m_ladders;

    std::unordered_map<uint32_t, size_t> m_areaIndexMap;
    std::unordered_map<uint32_t, size_t> m_ladderIndexMap;

    CNavMesh() = default;

    /**
     * @brief Parses a binary .nav file buffer matching Source 2 specifications.
     */
    bool LoadFromBuffer(const uint8_t* data, size_t dataSize);

    /**
     * @brief Retrieves a CNavArea pointer by unique ID.
     */
    [[nodiscard]] CNavArea* GetAreaByID(uint32_t id) noexcept;
    [[nodiscard]] const CNavArea* GetAreaByID(uint32_t id) const noexcept;

    /**
     * @brief Retrieves a CNavLadder pointer by unique ID.
     */
    [[nodiscard]] CNavLadder* GetLadderByID(uint32_t id) noexcept;
    [[nodiscard]] const CNavLadder* GetLadderByID(uint32_t id) const noexcept;

    /**
     * @brief Locates the nearest navigable area to world coordinates (GetNearestNav).
     */
    [[nodiscard]] CNavArea* GetNearestNavArea(
        const Vector3& pos,
        float maxDistance = 500.0f,
        uint32_t excludedFlags = NAV_MESH_CROUCH | NAV_MESH_CRAWL) noexcept;

    /**
     * @brief Executes A* pathfinding search heuristic (NavAreaBuildPath) from start to goal.
     * 
     * Incorporates Source 2 elevation penalties (3.0x multiplier on vertical climb)
     * and admissible/inadmissible heuristic factors.
     */
    bool FindPath(
        const Vector3& startPos,
        const Vector3& goalPos,
        CNavArea* startArea,
        CNavArea* goalArea,
        const INavPathCost& costFunc,
        std::vector<Vector3>& outPathWaypoints,
        float maxPathLength = 10000.0f,
        float inadmissibleHeuristicFactor = 1.0f);

    /**
     * @brief Computes 3D A* heuristic distance incorporating vertical elevation penalty.
     */
    static float ComputeHeuristicDistance(
        const Vector3& from,
        const Vector3& goal,
        float stepHeight = 18.0f) noexcept;
};

} // namespace cs2::navsystem

#endif // CS2_NAVSYSTEM_NAVMESH_H
```

```cpp
#ifndef CS2_FLATTENED_SERIALIZERS_H
#define CS2_FLATTENED_SERIALIZERS_H

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <optional>
#include "netmessage_framing.h"

namespace cs2::networksystem {

/**
 * @brief Field path operations in Source 2 entity state serialization.
 * Reconstructed from networksystem.dll (40-operation Huffman decoder @ 0x180272420).
 */
enum class FieldPathOp : uint8_t {
    PlusOne = 0,
    PlusTwo = 1,
    PlusThree = 2,
    PlusFour = 3,
    PlusN = 4,
    PushOneLeftDeltaZero = 5,
    PushOneLeftDeltaOne = 6,
    PushOneLeftDeltaN = 7,
    PushThreePackets = 8,
    PopAllButOneWalk = 9,
    PopOnePlusOne = 10,
    PopNPlusOne = 11,
    PopNPlusN = 12,
    Finish = 13
};

struct FieldPath {
    std::vector<int32_t> path;

    [[nodiscard]] std::string ToString() const;
};

struct SerializedFieldInfo {
    uint32_t fieldIndex;
    std::string varName;
    std::string varType;
    int32_t bitCount;
    float lowValue;
    float highValue;
};

/**
 * @brief Reconstructed Flattened Serializer walker from networksystem.dll.
 */
class CFlattenedSerializer {
public:
    CFlattenedSerializer(std::string typeName, uint32_t version);

    void AddField(SerializedFieldInfo field);
    [[nodiscard]] const std::vector<SerializedFieldInfo>& GetFields() const noexcept { return m_Fields; }
    [[nodiscard]] const std::string& GetTypeName() const noexcept { return m_TypeName; }
    [[nodiscard]] uint32_t GetVersion() const noexcept { return m_Version; }

    /**
     * @brief Decodes field paths from the wire bitstream.
     */
    static std::vector<FieldPath> DecodeFieldPaths(CBitReadStream& stream);

private:
    std::string m_TypeName;
    uint32_t m_Version;
    std::vector<SerializedFieldInfo> m_Fields;
};

} // namespace cs2::networksystem
```

### File: `game/networksystem/netmessage_framing.h` (networksystem.dll)
```cpp
#ifndef CS2_NETMESSAGE_FRAMING_H
#define CS2_NETMESSAGE_FRAMING_H

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstddef>
#include <optional>
#include <vector>

namespace cs2::networksystem {

/**
 * @brief Source 2 NetMessage Header parsed from wire bitstream.
 * Reconstructed from networksystem.dll (Wire parser FUN_1800201a0).
 */
struct NetMessageHeader {
    uint32_t messageId{0};
    uint32_t byteSize{0};
    size_t headerBitSize{0};
};

class CBitReadStream {
public:
    explicit CBitReadStream(const uint8_t* data, size_t bitCount);
    CBitReadStream(const uint8_t* data, size_t byteCount, bool isByteCount);

    [[nodiscard]] uint32_t ReadUBits(size_t numBits);
    [[nodiscard]] uint32_t ReadVarInt32();
    [[nodiscard]] bool ReadBytes(uint8_t* out, size_t byteCount);

    [[nodiscard]] size_t GetBitsRead() const noexcept { return m_BitOffset; }
    [[nodiscard]] size_t GetTotalBits() const noexcept { return m_TotalBits; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool HasOverflowed() const noexcept { return m_Overflow; }

private:
    const uint8_t* m_Data;
    size_t m_TotalBits;
    size_t m_BitOffset{0};
    bool m_Overflow{false};
};

class CBitWriteStream {
public:
    CBitWriteStream();

    void WriteUBits(uint32_t value, size_t numBits);
    void WriteVarInt32(uint32_t value);
    void WriteBytes(const uint8_t* data, size_t byteCount);

    [[nodiscard]] const std::vector<uint8_t>& GetData() const noexcept { return m_Buffer; }
    [[nodiscard]] size_t GetBitOffset() const noexcept { return m_BitOffset; }

private:
    std::vector<uint8_t> m_Buffer;
    size_t m_BitOffset{0};
};

/**
 * @brief NetMessage framing codec reconstructing networksystem.dll protocol.
 */
class CNetMessageFraming {
public:
    /**
     * @brief Decodes a variable-bit header (6/10/14/34 bits) + VarInt32 payload size.
     */
    static std::optional<NetMessageHeader> ReadHeader(CBitReadStream& stream);

    /**
     * @brief Encodes message ID with optimal variable-bit prefix and VarInt32 size.
     */
    static void WriteHeader(CBitWriteStream& stream, uint32_t messageId, uint32_t byteSize);
};

} // namespace cs2::networksystem

#endif // CS2_NETMESSAGE_FRAMING_H
```

```cpp
#ifndef CS2_SMOKE_VOXELS_H
#define CS2_SMOKE_VOXELS_H

#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>

namespace cs2::particles {

struct Vector3 {
    float x{0.0f}, y{0.0f}, z{0.0f};

    Vector3 operator+(const Vector3& o) const noexcept { return {x + o.x, y + o.y, z + o.z}; }
    Vector3 operator-(const Vector3& o) const noexcept { return {x - o.x, y - o.y, z - o.z}; }
    Vector3 operator*(float s) const noexcept { return {x * s, y * s, z * s}; }
    [[nodiscard]] float Dot(const Vector3& o) const noexcept { return x * o.x + y * o.y + z * o.z; }
    [[nodiscard]] float Length() const noexcept { return std::sqrt(Dot(*this)); }
};

/**
 * @brief Reconstructed Volumetric Smoke Grid from particles.dll.
 * Analyzed in FUN_1809b7f50 (LineOfSightThroughSmoke).
 */
class CSmokeVoxelGrid {
public:
    static constexpr int kGridDim = 32;
    static constexpr int kTotalVoxels = kGridDim * kGridDim * kGridDim; // 32,768

    CSmokeVoxelGrid(const Vector3& origin, float voxelSize);

    /**
     * @brief Encodes 3D integer coordinates into Morton Z-order index.
     */
    static uint32_t Morton3D(uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t z) noexcept;

    /**
     * @brief Initializes a spherical smoke plume of radius R.
     */
    void InitializeSphere(float radius, uint8_t density = 255);

    /**
     * @brief Performs 3D DDA raymarch to check if line of sight is obstructed by smoke.
     * Reconstructed from particles.dll @ FUN_1809b7f50.
     * @return true if visible (not blocked), false if smoke blocks vision.
     */
    [[nodiscard]] bool LineOfSight(const Vector3& start, const Vector3& end, float maxAccumulatedDensity = 120.0f) const;

    /**
     * @brief Carves a cylindrical or conical bullet tunnel through the smoke voxels.
     */
    void CarveBulletTunnel(const Vector3& start, const Vector3& end, float tunnelRadius);

    /**
     * @brief Carves a spherical cavity produced by an HE grenade detonation.
     */
    void DetonateHE(const Vector3& center, float blastRadius);

    [[nodiscard]] uint8_t GetVoxel(int x, int y, int z) const;
    void SetVoxel(int x, int y, int z, uint8_t val);

    [[nodiscard]] const Vector3& GetOrigin() const noexcept { return m_Origin; }
    [[nodiscard]] float GetVoxelSize() const noexcept { return m_VoxelSize; }

private:
    Vector3 m_Origin;
    float m_VoxelSize;
    std::vector<uint8_t> m_Voxels;
};

} // namespace cs2::particles

#endif // CS2_SMOKE_VOXELS_H
```

```cpp
#ifndef CS2_PULSE_INTERPRETER_H
#define CS2_PULSE_INTERPRETER_H

#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>
#include <memory>

namespace cs2::pulse_system {

enum class PulseOpcode : uint16_t {
    NOP = 0,
    LOAD_INT = 1,
    LOAD_FLOAT = 2,
    MOVE = 3,
    ADD_INT = 4,
    SUB_INT = 5,
    MUL_FLOAT = 6,
    JUMP = 7,
    JUMP_IF_ZERO = 8,
    CALL_DOMAIN_METHOD = 9,
    YIELD = 10,
    RETURN = 11
};

/**
 * @brief 56-byte aligned instruction descriptor matching pulse_system.dll @ 0x18008f810.
 */
struct alignas(8) PGDInstruction_t {
    PulseOpcode opcode{PulseOpcode::NOP};
    uint16_t flags{0};
    uint16_t dstReg{0};
    uint16_t srcRegA{0};
    uint16_t srcRegB{0};
    uint16_t pad{0};
    int64_t immInt{0};
    double immDouble{0.0};
    uint64_t domainMethodId{0};
    uint64_t extraData[2]{0, 0};
};
static_assert(sizeof(PGDInstruction_t) == 56, "PGDInstruction_t must match exactly 56 bytes");

enum class FiberState : uint8_t {
    Ready = 0,
    Running = 1,
    Yielded = 2,
    Terminated = 3
};

struct PulseFiber_t {
    uint32_t fiberId{0};
    FiberState state{FiberState::Ready};
    size_t programCounter{0};
    int64_t registers[16]{0};
};

/**
 * @brief Reconstructed Pulse Interpreter Engine from pulse_system.dll.
 */
class CPulseInterpreter {
public:
    CPulseInterpreter() = default;

    /**
     * @brief Loads program instructions into bytecode cache.
     */
    void LoadProgram(std::vector<PGDInstruction_t> instructions);

    /**
     * @brief Spawns a new execution fiber coroutine.
     */
    uint32_t SpawnFiber();

    /**
     * @brief Executes instructions for a fiber until yield or return.
     * Matches PulseInstructionDispatchLoop @ 0x18008f810.
     */
    FiberState StepFiber(uint32_t fiberId, size_t maxSteps = 1000);

    [[nodiscard]] const PulseFiber_t* GetFiber(uint32_t fiberId) const;

private:
    std::vector<PGDInstruction_t> m_Code;
    std::vector<PulseFiber_t> m_Fibers;
    uint32_t m_NextFiberId{1};
};

} // namespace cs2::pulse_system

#endif // CS2_PULSE_INTERPRETER_H
```

### File: `game/schemasystem/schemasystem.h` (schemasystem.dll)
```cpp
#ifndef CS2_SCHEMASYSTEM_H
#define CS2_SCHEMASYSTEM_H

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <unordered_map>

namespace cs2::schemasystem {

struct SchemaField {
    std::string name;
    std::string type;
    int32_t offset;
};

struct SchemaClass {
    std::string name;
    std::string moduleName;
    int32_t size;
    std::unordered_map<std::string, SchemaField> fields;
};

/**
 * @brief Reconstructed CSchemaSystem from schemasystem.dll
 * Verified MurmurHash2 implementation matching schemasystem.dll @ 0x180010380.
 */
class CSchemaSystem {
public:
    static CSchemaSystem& Get();

    static constexpr uint32_t MurmurHash2(std::string_view str) noexcept {
        const uint32_t len = static_cast<uint32_t>(str.length());
        if (len == 0) return 0;

        constexpr uint32_t m = 0x5bd1e995;
        constexpr int r = 24;

        uint32_t h = len ^ 0xbaadfeed;
        const char* data = str.data();
        uint32_t remaining = len;

        while (remaining >= 4) {
            uint32_t k = static_cast<uint8_t>(data[0]) |
                        (static_cast<uint8_t>(data[1]) << 8) |
                        (static_cast<uint8_t>(data[2]) << 16) |
                        (static_cast<uint8_t>(data[3]) << 24);

            k *= m;
            k ^= k >> r;
            k *= m;

            h *= m;
            h ^= k;

            data += 4;
            remaining -= 4;
        }

        if (remaining == 3) h ^= static_cast<uint8_t>(data[2]) << 16;
        if (remaining >= 2) h ^= static_cast<uint8_t>(data[1]) << 8;
        if (remaining >= 1) {
            h ^= static_cast<uint8_t>(data[0]);
            h *= m;
        }

        h ^= h >> 13;
        h *= m;
        h ^= h >> 15;

        return h;
    }

    void RegisterClass(const std::string& moduleName, const std::string& className, int32_t classSize);
    void RegisterField(const std::string& className, const std::string& fieldName, const std::string& type, int32_t offset);

    [[nodiscard]] const SchemaClass* FindDeclaredClass(const std::string& className) const;
    [[nodiscard]] int32_t GetFieldOffset(const std::string& className, const std::string& fieldName) const;

private:
    CSchemaSystem();
    std::unordered_map<std::string, SchemaClass> m_Classes;
};

} // namespace cs2::schemasystem

#endif // CS2_SCHEMASYSTEM_H
```

```cpp
constexpr uint16_t CHAR_TEX_CLIP         = 'I'; // 0x49

constexpr uint16_t CHAR_TEX_FOLIAGE      = 'O'; // 0x4F

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 3D Vector Math for Ballistic Calculations
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct Vector3 {
    float x{0.0f}, y{0.0f}, z{0.0f};

    constexpr Vector3() noexcept = default;
    constexpr Vector3(float fx, float fy, float fz) noexcept : x(fx), y(fy), z(fz) {}

    Vector3 operator+(const Vector3& o) const noexcept { return {x + o.x, y + o.y, z + o.z}; }
    Vector3 operator-(const Vector3& o) const noexcept { return {x - o.x, y - o.y, z - o.z}; }
    Vector3 operator*(float s) const noexcept { return {x * s, y * s, z * s}; }
    Vector3 operator/(float s) const noexcept { return {x / s, y / s, z / s}; }

    [[nodiscard]] float Dot(const Vector3& o) const noexcept { return x * o.x + y * o.y + z * o.z; }
    [[nodiscard]] float LengthSqr() const noexcept { return Dot(*this); }
    [[nodiscard]] float Length() const noexcept { return std::sqrt(LengthSqr()); }
    [[nodiscard]] Vector3 Normalized() const noexcept {
        float l = Length();
        return l > 1e-6f ? (*this) * (1.0f / l) : Vector3{0, 0, 0};
    }
};

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Reconstructed 32-Byte Rubikon Physics Surface Property Layout
// Reversed from FUN_180be1120 in server.dll (surfaceproperties_game.txt)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct SurfaceData_t {

    float jumpFactor{1.0f};                        // +0x04
    float bulletPenetrationDistanceModifier{1.0f}; // +0x08 (flPenetrationDistance)
    float bulletPenetrationDamageModifier{0.16f};  // +0x0C (flDamageModifier, default 0.16)
    uint32_t stringToken{0};                       // +0x10 (MurmurHash2 / FNV-1a token)
    uint16_t materialChar{CHAR_TEX_CONCRETE};      // +0x14 (e.g. 'C', 'W', 'M', 'G', 'F', 'Y')
    uint16_t soundStackMaterial{0};                // +0x16
    uint8_t flags18{0};                            // +0x18
    bool isStairs{false};                          // +0x19
    bool isSlippery{false};                        // +0x1A
    uint8_t flags1B{0};                            // +0x1B
    bool reflectBullets{false};                    // +0x1C
    bool reduceWeaponImpact{false};                // +0x1D
    bool bulletsPenetrate{true};                   // +0x1E
    uint8_t pad1F{0};                              // +0x1F
};

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// In-Flight Bullet Parameter Block
// Corresponds to param_2 array in FUN_180a8fca0
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct BulletData_t {
    float currentDamage{0.0f};      // param_2[0]: Current accumulated damage
    float penetrationPower{1.0f};   // param_2[1]: Weapon penetration power (e.g. 1.0, 2.0, 2.5)
    float rangeModifier{0.98f};     // param_2[2]: Weapon range falloff modifier (e.g. 0.98)
    float maxRange{8192.0f};        // param_2[3]: Trace scale / maximum weapon range
    int penetrationCount{4};        // param_2[4]: Remaining penetrating objects
    bool stopped{false};            // param_2[5]: Flag set if bullet is stopped
};

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Surface Hit & Ray Interval Descriptor
// Corresponds to param_3 interval record in FUN_180a6ca20 / FUN_180a8fca0
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct SurfaceHitData_t {
    float tEnter{0.0f};             // Entry fraction along ray [0.0, 1.0]
    float tExit{1.0f};              // Exit fraction along ray [0.0, 1.0]
    uint32_t flags{1};              // Bit 0: 0 = Air interval, 1 = Solid material interval
    Vector3 enterPoint;             // World coordinate where ray entered
    Vector3 exitPoint;              // World coordinate where ray exited
    Vector3 enterNormal;            // Surface normal at entry
    Vector3 exitNormal;             // Surface normal at exit
    SurfaceData_t enterSurface;     // Physical surface descriptor at entry
    SurfaceData_t exitSurface;      // Physical surface descriptor at exit
    bool enterIsGrate{false};       // Grate / chainlink flag at entry (Bit 13)
    bool exitIsGrate{false};        // Grate / chainlink flag at exit (Bit 13)
    bool isTeammate{false};         // True if hit pawn belongs to shooter's team
    uint32_t hitEntityHandle{0xFFFFFFFF}; // Entity handle of hit object
    int hitGroupId{0};              // Hitgroup (0=generic, 1=head, 2=chest, etc.)
};

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Authoritative Bullet Impact Event Data
// Emitted as "bullet_impact" event in FUN_180a70240 @ 0x180a70a61
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct BulletImpact_t {

    Vector3 normal;

};

    Vector3 mins;
    Vector3 maxs;

};

    Vector3 vDirection;

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Authoritative Bullet Penetration & Surface Physics Pipeline
// Reconstructed clean-room from server.dll
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
class CBulletPenetration {
public:
    /**
     * @brief Authoritative damage distance falloff formula:
     * flDamage = baseDamage * pow(flRangeModifier, distance / 500.0f)
     * Reverse engineered from FUN_180a8fca0 @ 0x180a8fd0a

     * Reverse engineered from FUN_180a8fca0 in server.dll.
     * Computes material absorption, penetration power reduction, and damage loss.

     * @param hit Surface interval information (thickness, materials, normals)
     * @param ffBulletPenetration Value of ConVar ff_damage_bullet_penetration (default false)
     * @return true if bullet penetrates through surface; false if stopped

                                          const SurfaceHitData_t& hit,
                                          bool ffBulletPenetration = false);

     * Reverse engineered from ClipTraceToPlayers (FUN_180181cd0 in server.dll).
     * Tests candidate players within a 40-unit skin expansion margin.
     * 
     * @param vStart Ray origin
     * @param vEnd Ray termination
     * @param players Candidate active player pawns
     * @param attackerHandle Handle of shooter to prevent self-collision
     * @param outHit Output hit information if a player was intercepted
     * @return true if a player was hit, false otherwise
     */

                                  const Vector3& vEnd,
                                  const std::vector<HitPlayerPawn_t>& players,
                                  uint32_t attackerHandle,
```

```cpp
#ifndef CS2_SERVER_CONTROLLER_PAWN_H
#define CS2_SERVER_CONTROLLER_PAWN_H

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>

namespace cs2::server {

constexpr uint32_t INVALID_EHANDLE = 0xFFFFFFFF;
constexpr uint32_t ENTRY_INDEX_MASK = 0x7FFF;
constexpr uint32_t SERIAL_NUMBER_SHIFT = 15;

/**
 * @brief 32-bit CEntityHandle packed bitfield
 * Bits 0..14: Entry Index (0..32,767)
 * Bits 15..31: Serial Number (ABA protection)
 */
struct EntityHandle {
    uint32_t raw = INVALID_EHANDLE;

    constexpr EntityHandle() noexcept = default;
    constexpr explicit EntityHandle(uint32_t val) noexcept : raw(val) {}
    constexpr EntityHandle(uint32_t entryIndex, uint32_t serialNum) noexcept
        : raw((entryIndex & ENTRY_INDEX_MASK) | (serialNum << SERIAL_NUMBER_SHIFT)) {}

    [[nodiscard]] constexpr bool IsValid() const noexcept { return raw != INVALID_EHANDLE; }
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr uint32_t GetEntryIndex() const noexcept { return raw & ENTRY_INDEX_MASK; }
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr uint32_t GetSerialNumber() const noexcept { return raw >> SERIAL_NUMBER_SHIFT; }
};

struct PlayerPawn {
    EntityHandle handle;
    EntityHandle controllerHandle;
    int health = 100;
    bool isAlive = true;
    bool isBot = false;
};

struct PlayerController {
    EntityHandle handle;
    EntityHandle pawnHandle;
    std::string playerName;
    int ping = 15;
    int score = 0;
};

/**
 * @brief Reconstructed Controller vs Pawn Topology from server.dll
 * Decoupled controller entity possession, observer camera handover, and bot takeover.
 */
class CPlayerLifecycleManager {
public:
    static bool PossessPawn(PlayerController& controller, PlayerPawn& pawn);
    static bool OnPawnDeath(PlayerController& controller, PlayerPawn& deadPawn);
    static bool TakeoverBotPawn(PlayerController& controller, PlayerPawn& botPawn);

} // namespace cs2::server
```

```cpp
/**
 * @file hit_registration_damage.h
 * @brief Clean-room C++20 reconstruction of CS2 Hit Registration, HitGroup Scaling & Armor Damage Absorption.
 *
 * Reconstructed from server.dll:
 *   - CCSPlayerPawn::IsArmored                    (Baseline RVA: 0x00aca700, Build 26144732 RVA: 0x00ad7ba0)
 *   - CCSPlayerPawn::ApplyArmorDamageCalculation  (Baseline RVA: 0x00a81050, Build 26144732 RVA: 0x00a8e500)

#pragma once

#include <cstdint>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>

namespace cs2::server {

/**
 * @brief Source 2 HitGroup_t enumeration used in CGameTrace & CTakeDamageInfo.
 */
enum class HitGroup_t : int32_t {
    HITGROUP_GENERIC   = 0,
    HITGROUP_HEAD      = 1,
    HITGROUP_CHEST     = 2,
    HITGROUP_STOMACH   = 3,
    HITGROUP_LEFTARM   = 4,
    HITGROUP_RIGHTARM  = 5,
    HITGROUP_LEFTLEG   = 6,
    HITGROUP_RIGHTLEG  = 7,
    HITGROUP_NECK      = 8,
    HITGROUP_GEAR      = 10
};

/**
 * @brief Damage type bitflags inside CTakeDamageInfo (+0x4C).
 */
enum DamageBits_t : uint32_t {
    DMG_GENERIC             = 0,
    DMG_CRUSH               = (1 << 0),
    DMG_BULLET              = (1 << 1),
    DMG_SLASH               = (1 << 2),
    DMG_BURN                = (1 << 3),
    DMG_BLAST               = (1 << 6),
    DMG_CLUB                = (1 << 7),
    DMG_SHOCK               = (1 << 8),
    DMG_FALL                = (1 << 5),
    DMG_HEADSHOT            = (1 << 30)
};

/**
 * @brief Reconstructed server-side damage scaling ConVars.

struct ServerDamageConVars {
    float mp_damage_scale_ct_head = 1.0f;
    float mp_damage_scale_t_head  = 1.0f;
    float mp_damage_scale_ct_body = 1.0f;
    float mp_damage_scale_t_body  = 1.0f;
    bool  mp_damage_headshot_only = false;
};

/**

 */
struct CCSPlayer_ItemServices {
    bool m_bHasDefuser = false; // +0x40
    bool m_bHasHelmet  = false; // +0x41
    bool m_bHasHeavyArmor = false; // +0x42
};

/**

struct CTakeDamageInfo {
    float       m_flDamage           = 0.0f;  // +0x44: Scaled damage accumulator
    float       m_flOriginalDamage   = 0.0f;  // +0x48: Base pre-armor damage
    uint32_t    m_bitsDamageType     = DMG_BULLET; // +0x4C: Damage type bitfield
    float       m_flArmorPenetration = 1.0f;  // Weapon m_flArmorRatio (e.g. 1.55 for AK-47, 1.40 for M4A4)
    HitGroup_t  m_nHitGroup          = HitGroup_t::HITGROUP_GENERIC;
};

/**

 */
struct DamageCalculationResult {
    float   flRawDistanceDamage  = 0.0f;
    float   flHitgroupScaledDmg  = 0.0f;
    float   flFinalHealthDamage  = 0.0f;
    float   flAbsorbedByArmor    = 0.0f;

    int32_t nRemainingHealth     = 0;
    int32_t nRemainingArmor      = 0;
```
